crop.notes: Allen notice is the first item; the clipping also includes two unrelated gun club items (Compton Hill Gun Club, Independent Gun Club).

ocr.notes: Allen notice mostly right ('Free fm port' for 'Free concert'); the gun club items are badly garbled.

title.suggested: Notice of Free Concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 30, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: In April 1892 Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised free concerts every evening, with only the best singers engaged; he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Recurring weekly notice (843-847 and others in 1892). Focus suggested primary because the item itself is entirely about Allen, though it is only a three-line notice; 'passing' would also be defensible.
